cd /work/crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 TMPDIR=/work/tmp cargo +nightly-2026-10-01 fmt --package alacritty_terminal -- --check

cd /work/crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 TMPDIR=/work/tmp cargo +1.99.1 fmt --package alacritty_terminal -- --check
/work/clock

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('alacritty_terminal/src/term/mod.rs')
s = p.read_text().replace('                let position: &[u8] =\n                    if pending_wrap { b"\\x1b[2;8Hq" } else { b"\\x1b[2;4H" };', '                let position: &[u8] = if pending_wrap { b"\\x1b[2;8Hq" } else { b"\\x1b[2;4H" };')

RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 TMPDIR=/work/tmp RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1 rustfmt +1.99.1 --edition 2021 --config skip_children=true --check alacritty_terminal/src/term/mod.rs
